findings.confidence: confirmed visible for old loaded bundle
findings.expected: Airborne guidance uses the visible destination beacon and appropriate flight instructions.
findings.actual: During flight, Road ahead blocked / check the map and changing road-route distances appeared despite a nearby beacon. Reproduced on multiple airborne frames. Parent amended the source afterward; this preserved delivery tab did not reload and does not verify that amendment.

observations: Offer controls were visible and separated from minimap at 594x466. Tutorial tip could be dismissed before driving.

Several tight residential turns overshot or clipped a curb/storefront edge. Recovery returned the car to a visible clear street and forward driving continued. These interactions are recorded as manual handling difficulty, not a confirmed new geometry defect.

Following road segments reduced route distance, while missed turns caused rerouting. Off-road states displayed an explicit Return to a road for GPS message with approximate direct distance rather than drawing a fabricated connector.
Normal driving charged boost from 2.5 s to 12.5 s. Flight was not activated in this segment.
Traffic collision toasts for bike/auto appeared during approach. No delivery cargo was carried at those times.

First flight used the earned 12.5 s boost. Visible thrusters, travel above roofs, exhausted charge and natural descent onto a roof were observed. Normal R roof recovery returned the car to a clear street at 130 m / 78 s with all eight slices.

Reverse movement briefly remained near the same point; a three-point turn and forward driving resumed movement. Driver alignment and curb contact were visible, so no geometry blocker is claimed from that attempt.

Road driving earned another 5 s boost. A second short flight crossed toward the visible teal beacon, exhausted charge and landed on a roof approximately 10 m from the destination. The normal R roof recovery reached the roadside ring at 5 m / 0 km/h with the explicit handover prompt.
No cargo slices were lost during the observed flights, roof landings or recovery. Heat cooled with active time. These are two roof landings, not proof of a controlled natural street landing.

Original airborne screenshot and repeated live states on build 8c24575 showed Road ahead blocked / check the map and road-derived distances while flying. Parent subsequently amended flight guidance in source; that later build was not loaded in this preserved tab.
coverageLimitations: This is one completed visible pickup-to-handover route, with normal flight and two roof recoveries. It does not prove every city route or natural street landing.
This preserved tab does not verify later camera and airborne-HUD amendments; those require a fresh-build check.
This run does not verify exact real-world shop names, shop order, facade geometry or citywide accuracy.
No other paused game tabs were resumed or changed.
